title: Autopilot run state (mutable, ungated — breadcrumbs, not the source of truth)
description: Written by scripts/autopilot.py. The authoritative phase always comes from `python3 scripts/gate.py status`; engaged_phase and paused.next_action are hints for a human reading the file, and must never be acted on in place of state detection.

status.description: engaged = a run is live and the guard hook is armed. paused = stopped, safe to inspect. off = explicitly disabled.

engaged_phase.description: Phase reported by gate.py at engage time. A record of what was true then, not a claim about now.

threshold_pct.description: Percent of the 5-hour rate-limit window at which the run pauses itself.

context_tokens.description: Orchestrator context size, in tokens, at which `check` halts the run at the next unit boundary so the user can start a fresh session.

stop_at_gates.description: Always true in this version — gates are human decisions (SKILL.md Step 5).

last_check.description: Usage as of the last engage/log/disengage. `check` is read-only and does not stamp this.

log.description: One entry per unit of work attempted. Append-only within a run.
